text: Issue row 'auth certificate 66% -60%/min left' reads as rate + 'time left'; 'left' is actually a direction (later changes to 'far side'). Ambiguous with the rate right before it.

Helper line 'Kofi is helping: patching ui, 2:16 left' is back; in shots d1/d2 (3 open issues) the Kofi line was missing from HUD entirely, so it looked like Kofi had left. Meanwhile auth (certificate 24%) silently vanished from issues - presumably Kofi patched it, but nothing said so.
Helper line 'Kofi is helping: waiting for it to settle, 1:06 left' runs off the right edge of the 640px window (last letters clipped).
Held W 10s pushing; boulder slipped away and rolled back 27 m behind me with no visible cue (no stamina bar shown during push, no 'it slipped' message). Next 0.3 went 19 m -> 27 m.
Night falls fast (about 8 minutes of real time in); with the software renderer the hill and boulder become near-black, module glows are the only cue. Hard to orient.
Issue table columns collide: 'search  uses storage86%' - the problem text runs into the percent column.

Holding W into the boulder from below (crosshair on it, router prompt showing) moves it ~0-1 m in 8 s. Weight bar full 'heavy'; no stamina bar is shown at all, so I can't tell if I'm exhausted, too heavy, or just not touching it.

History says 'No climb has finished yet. Each one that does leaves a cairn at the trailhead', yet the trailhead already shows world labels '0.1' and '0.2' (signposts/cairns?) and we start at version 0.2. Also the current row credits 'patched 4' and 'helpers 1' but nothing about what Kofi did.
Held F for 5 s and then 8 s on 'router: DOWN (0%), uses auth' with prompt 'F to refactor it into auth' shown: nothing happened, no progress bar, no message why.

Second time: holding W 8 s from directly below (no direction hint = facing uphill), the boulder drifts sideways off my push, I keep walking up the grass and it rolls back 19 m behind me. No 'you lost the boulder' message; the only cue is 'Next' jumping from 23 m back to 27 m.

Solo after Kofi left, rot outruns one player: within ~12 min of Kofi leaving, users 100 -> 0, health 12%, weight 'too heavy to push uphill', 8 open issues, several 'under: roll it' that cannot be reached because it is too heavy to roll. Feels like an unrecoverable death spiral with no fail state or hint what to do.

History (Tab) after ~19 game-min: one row 'now 0.x 19 min, 7 modules, 0 users, patched 11, retired 1, refactored 0, down 13, helpers 1' + 'No climb has finished yet.' It is a stat table, not a story: no mention of Kofi by name, how long he stayed, what he patched, when the outages hit or when users left. 'now 0.x' instead of 0.2->0.3. Text drawn over the 3D scene without a backing panel.

The '0.1'/'0.2' labels are terrace signposts further down the valley, not cairns - so the boulder starts on the 0.2 terrace, not at a trailhead. The floating orange version labels read like cairn/history markers at first.
